subject.title: feat: support signed ClawHub default feed

question: Should this draft land as the combined signed marketplace feed trust stack, or should maintainers require the prerequisite verifier/config/state/CLI slices to land first and keep this PR to the default ClawHub trust-root layer?
rationale: The branch defines marketplace content trust roots, signed-envelope acceptance, fail-closed behavior, persisted trust metadata, public operator docs, and a default-feed security claim, so automation should not choose the permanent trust boundary or stack sequencing.

options.title: Land Prerequisites First
options.body: Settle the verifier, signed config, refresh-state, and CLI trust-state PRs first, then rebase this PR into a smaller default ClawHub trust-root change with matching docs and proof.

options.title: Review Combined Stack
options.body: Allow this PR to remain the combined landing vehicle, but require the verifier cap fix, bundled-key/docs fix, conflict resolution, and current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Hold For Production Key
options.body: Keep the PR draft until ClawHub generates the production keypair and the real public key can be bundled and smoke-tested end to end.

recommendation.title: Land Prerequisites First
recommendation.body: Settle the verifier, signed config, refresh-state, and CLI trust-state PRs first, then rebase this PR into a smaller default ClawHub trust-root change with matching docs and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored recent trust-stack repair commits and are the clearest available owner for verifier/config correctness and sequencing.
